model_type: CIOMS-domain fine-tuned CNN plus bidirectional LSTM text recognizer trained with CTC loss
integrity_statement: The model was fine-tuned from the verified generic CRNN using synthetic CIOMS-rendered crop images. The protected real evaluation PDF, Plain Python, OCR, and LLM outputs were excluded from training.
known_limitation: The trained recognizer handles single-line text crops. Multiline CIOMS regions require line segmentation before recognition.
